name: hey-api-ts
description: Hey API (@hey-api/openapi-ts) documentation. Use for generating TypeScript clients, SDKs, types, and validators from OpenAPI specs — configuration (input/output/parser/Vite), HTTP clients (Fetch, Axios, Ky, Next.js, Nuxt, oFetch, Angular), and plugins (Zod, Valibot, ArkType, TanStack Query, SWR, Fastify, NestJS, Hono, oRPC, MSW, Faker, and more).
